readiness_evidence: Not offered yet: this release teaches the assistant which harness replay a rollout belongs to. No booking, payment, or calendar behavior changed.
Verified harnesses stay deferred on every version until an internal change records their own replay. The general status is for every harness without one.

Offline: update decision tests cover a general recommendation staying deferred for a verified harness, a verified recommendation staying deferred for everyone else, and one replay promoting two harnesses that share it.
Existing businesses, the registry, and saved session files are unchanged: no USP, UCP, or platform profile version changed and no request shape changed.

Hosted replay (base44-superagent): on 22/10/26 Base44 Superagent ran CLI 0.10.2 with skill 0.57.4, which carries every change in this release, and passed its replay with the update decision set to this replay. The 0.10.2 notes hold the full evidence and caveats.

The replay of this release alone on this harness stopped at a defect that 0.10.1 fixes. This record keeps the Base44 Superagent rollout cumulative from the first release that reads replay rollouts: an installed 0.10.0 or 0.10.1 is offered 0.10.2, because an update targets the newest release this replay recommends, while 0.10.2 stays recommended.
Older CLIs do not read replay rollouts, so a Base44 Superagent install starts from the approved release in its install guide, not from an update offer.

Hosted replay (grok-bot): on 22/10/26 Grok Bot ran CLI 0.9.1 with skill 0.57.1, resumed a selected $1 booking after Update Bot's Computer changed the boot id while preserving the saved session and Link sign-in, completed the charge, stated that no calendar event was added because the harness cannot pass its connector token, answered status from the confirmed booking, and runtime doctor reported survived_restart true, healthy true, and no findings.

Hosted replay (grok-bot): the $2 HVAC-Koby AC Diagnostic & Inspection checkout disclosed that the full amount was due at the appointment, created no Link spend request, charged nothing, and confirmed the booking after checkout completion. A second checkout was abandoned before policy acceptance with no order, charge, refund, or confirmed booking and no second USP cancellation; the confirmed throwaway was then canceled with no fee or refund.
The live HVAC-Koby business and current registry returned the paid and pay-at-appointment services used by the replay. The saved 0.9.1 session survived a fresh Grok computer byte for byte.

Offline: update decision tests cover a general recommendation staying deferred for Grok Bot, a Grok recommendation staying deferred for every other replay, and one replay promoting two harnesses that share it.

user_summary: A verified booking harness is offered an update only after its own replay passes.
